newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary MBFB raises Konzumbank capital by HUF 1bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary MBFB raises Konzumbank capital by HUF 1bln.

text.p: Hungarian Investment and Development Bank (MBFB) Rt has increased Konzumbank's capital by one billion forints, Konzumbank said to its shareholders at Friday's extraordinary general meeting.
The capital increase brings Konzumbank's capital to 3.374 billion forints, Hungarian news agency MTI reported.
Konzumbank's majority owner is MBFB with a 72.8 percent stake, Toketars Kft has a 16.3 percent stake, the Finance Ministry holds 7.6 percent and privatisation agency APV Rt 1.1 percent.

MBFB Rt has registered capital of HUF 18.18bn and APV Rt holds 62.77pc. 23.71pc is owned by the Treasury Assets Directorate and 13.42pc by the Ministry of Finance, while 0.1pc of the shares are in the bank's own portfolio.
